notes.title: Update 1.03b3a is Now Live
notes.notes:
Update 1.03b3a has been released which fixes the following issues:
- Fixed Kelly-Anne's Game from stalling progress if the ball gets stuck in a horizontal loop. 
- Fixed Achievements not unlocking on MacOS.

Remember, if you encounter any bugs please share them with me on the pinned thread in the Steam forums.

Stay safe, wear those masks, and happy hacking!
Lint

notes.title: GREYHAT updated to version 1.03b1s
notes.notes:
GREYHAT - A Digital Detective Adventure has been updated to version 1.03b1s. The changelog is as below:

[list]
[*]Fixed layering issue wherein the Exit Screen in certain levels were being rendered underneath open windows.
[*]Automatic Tunneling now takes half the time
[/list]

Happy Hacking!

notes.title: Update 1..03b1r is now live
notes.notes:
Hello hackers,

Update 1.03b1r is now live. The changelog is below:
[list]
[*]Salim's car no longer speeds up as much when you get him down to 100m, making it easier to catch him
[*]Kelly-Anne's game has been tweaked to be easier to beat, with more lives and a slower, more predictable ball.
[/list]

Please keep your feedback coming, it really helps.

Happy hacking!

Lint

notes.title: Accessibility Update for Tone Puzzle Difficulties in GREYHAT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thanks to the feedback of a subset of players, I've added an accessibility feature that helps players who have difficulty solving certain puzzles that require them to differentiate between certain musical tones. This feature can be activated from the Settings screen.

New players will also be asked to solve a quick challenge at the Hek-Con registration screen to determine if they will find this option useful.

Kindly update the game to 1.03b1q to access this option.

Thanks once again for your feedback, and happy hacking!

Lint
